title: Sunrise at Lake Louise and Explore Moraine Lake with Local Guide
includes: Leisure Time: Enjoy 2.5 Hours at Lake Louise & 2 Hours at Moraine Lake.
Small Group Experience: Maximum 13 guests for a more intimate, personalized adventure.
Rain Protection: Ponchos and umbrellas provided.
Headlamps & Hiking Poles: Navigate trails and viewpoints with confidence.
Experienced Local Guide: Gain fascinating insights about the region.
Complimentary Warm Beverages: Local coffee, tea, hot chocolate, and water refills
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum Age: 6 years. For safety and comfort, we cannot accommodate children under 6.

Prior to your tour, we will send you a message with all important pickup details to help you prepare for your experience. This information is provided to ensure a smooth, easy, and stress-free start to your tour. If you have any questions before then, please feel free to reach out anytime.

Our tours proceed rain, shine, or snow (yes, even in the summer!). However, in extreme weather conditions, we prioritize your safety and comfort—so we’ll either reschedule your tour or offer a refund.
Watching the sunrise at Lake Louise is chilly! Dress in layers to stay warm and ready for unpredictable mountain weather.

In order to participate all adults must sign a waiver prior to the tour. A waiver must also be completed by the parent or guardian of any child under the age of 18. Failure to complete the waiver will result in the cancellation of your tour.
No-shows, missed departures, or unused services are non-refundable.
We require at least 4 guests for the tour to proceed. If we don’t reach this minimum number, we will offer you options to reschedule or receive a full refund.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Witness the tranquility of sunrise at two of the Canadian Rockies' most iconic lakes on this intimate tour. Begin your adventure with early morning pickup from Canmore or Banff, allowing you to immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Lake Louise as the first light touches its turquoise waters. After enjoying a warm beverage and ample time to explore, continue to Moraine Lake, where you can hike or stroll along the lakeshore while marveling at its stunning views. With an experienced local guide, gain insights into the region's wildlife and history for a deeper connection to the landscape.

- Early morning pickup from Canmore or Banff for convenience
- 2.5 hours at Lake Louise and 2 hours at Moraine Lake to explore
- Small group size of 13 for a personalized experience
- Complimentary warm beverages and cozy chairs provided for comfort
